fields.description: Program Description This program is a 4 year(8 semester) program. For the first 3 semesters, students studyin TongjiUniversity. For the 4th to 7th semesters, studentscan choose to continue studying in Tongji University or studyinga double degree at the University of New South Wales in Australia. For the 8th semester,students of the both optionsstudyin Tongji University. Applicants who wish to apply for thedouble degree program shouldindicate in the application materials. Dual-degree graduates will receive undergraduate degreesfrom two universities and can take the Architects Professional Qualification Examination in China and Australia and other Commonwealth countries. Main courses: Art Modeling (1), Art History (2), Design Introduction (2), Design Basics (6), Art Modeling (2), Architectural Mechanics (4), History of Architecture (2), Introduction to Architecture (2), Architectural Design (1) Architectural Design Basics (6), Artistic Modeling Practice (4), Historical Environmental Records (4), Computer Graphics (2), Building Structures (4), Urban Reading (2), Architectural Generation Principles (2) , Architectural Design (2), Architectural Design (6), Building Information Modeling, Architectural Design (3), Architectural History and Theory (3), Architectural Design (4), Structure and Construction (2), Environment and Architecture ( 2) Architectural design (5), Architectural history and theory (2), Architectural design (6), Building regulations, Architectural disaster prevention (2), Vocational education for architects (2), Graduation designDegree conferred: Bachelor of Architecture Engineering from Tongji University. Students of the dual degree program also conferred a Bachelor of Science degree in Architecture from the University of New South Wales.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. A Chinese Name You can create a Chinese name for yourself, write it in document and upload here since it is necessary for applying to Tongji University. If you didn't upload or fill in application form, then we will have to create a Chinese name for you. You may communicate with teacher to change it later though. * 2. Physical examination form for foreigners (within six months) or a current valid Chinese visa. -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s recommendation, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 3. A Self-introduction Video -Please speak in English or Chinese. -The video should be at least 2 minutes long, in MP4 format, and less than 7 MB. -Include a brief self-introduction, your study plan after enrollment, reasons for applying to this program and university in China, and your plans after graduation. -You may also highlight your language ability, interests, confidence, and motivation. * 4. Supplementary Professional Materials - Like Portfolios You can upload portfolios here to prove your ability, if it is too big to be uploaded here, you put those documents in cloud storage services, and download the form here, fill it with related information, and upload the filled word document here again so teacher can access and check your portfolios. You can download a template or sample from here . * 5. Proof of language proficiency * 6. Personal information page of your passport (Passport valid until January 30, 2027 and beyond). * 7. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 8. Original or notarized transcripts of all courses in high school – For a transcript in a language other than Chinese and English, the original notarized copy of the Chinese or English translation must be provided. The notarized copy must be issued by a Chinese embassy or consulate abroad, or a foreign embassy and consulate in China; – We recommend that you attach a description of the evaluation criteria of the transcripts. – The results of the national senior high school entrance examination or the internationally accepted test results of the country of origin, such as UEC/A Level/AP/IB/SAT/ACT, can also be submitted as supplementary materials. * 9. High school diploma – For a certificate in a language other than Chinese and English, the original notarized copy of the Chinese or English translation must be provided. The notarized copy must be issued by a Chinese embassy or consulate abroad, or a foreign embassy or consulate in China; – The original graduation certificate issued by the school of a new high school graduate needs to be provided. Upon admission, you need to bring the original high school graduation certificate for verification during registration; – For a Malaysian SPM diploma,the certificate of completion of STPM or completion of one-year preparatory studies and transcript of the preparatory courses are also required. * 10. Other Materials Materials and works that can prove the applicant's training, activities, competitions, and other related experience (electronic files in PDF format, no larger than 10 MB) in terms of art basics, space modeling ability, art aesthetics, and comprehensive development. * 11. Personal statement Please write your introduction according to the personal statement template (undergraduate) in the teaching language of the professional program (for example, the statement for a program taught in Chinese should be written in Chinese, and the statement for a program taught in English should be written in English). You can download a template or sample from here . * 12. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. - For Architecture: the required subjects are Mathematics and Physics — the test papers need to be in English. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Self-supporting students: applicants aged between 18 and 35 (up to and including December 31 in the year of application) Non-Chinese citizens who have graduated from high school or above and are in good health; 2. Applicants who are immigrants from the Chinese mainland, Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan (China) and are a foreign national, or whose par ents are both Chinese citizens and have settled abroad, or who have been a foreign national since birth must meet the requirements of the Ministry of Education's Jiao Wai Han [2020] No.12; 3. Applicants under the age of 18 (before August 31 in the current year) should click here to view the requirements. 4. Proof of language proficiency IELTS 6.5, TOEFL IBT 81 or above. 5. Students applying for the Architecture(InternationalClass)program must take the CSCA Mathematics and Physics exams(the exam papers are in English).
